name: JointMMSafe
description: JointMMSafe is a large-scale human-graded benchmark for evaluating safety in multimodal foundation models, focusing on joint image-text safety combinations. It introduces a borderline severity level alongside safe and unsafe levels for fine-grained safety evaluation and exposes weaknesses in joint multimodal understanding and alignment.
reputation: A recent specialized safety benchmark for multimodal foundation models, gaining attention in the multimodal safety community but not yet broadly standardized.
notes: Evaluates joint image-text safety understanding; introduces borderline severity level; reveals alignment instability and under-refusal issues.
